title: MBSB Bank and WIH Malaysia sign US$243m cement plant financing deal
summary: MBSB Bank and WIH Malaysia sign US$243m cement plant financing deal
body_markdown: **Malaysia:** MBSB Bank and WIH Malaysia Building Materials signed a US$243m financing agreement to develop an integrated cement plant and limestone quarry in Gua Musang, Kelantan. The project includes a 7500t/day plant, a 12MW waste heat recovery system expected to supply 26% of its electricity requirements, and biomass fuel to replace up to 30% of coal consumption. The facility is intended to serve demand in Malaysia’s east coast and other parts of Peninsular Malaysia, with decarbonisation measures supporting WIH Malaysia’s commitment to net-zero emissions by 2050.
